description: Draws an institution's 13F portfolio in the chat as an interactive map and table of its positions. Call it when the user asks what an institution or fund manager owns, or when the portfolio is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetInstitutionPortfolio returns the figures.

reportDate.description: Quarter-end 13F report date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the latest available).
